name: agent-manager.friction-digest
purpose: Rank the recurring deterministic friction fingerprints whose suspected owner is one scenario, over the most recent runs inside a window, with owner-confidence counts and no estimation.

scenario.description: Owning scenario slug to digest, matched against each episode's suspectedOwnerScenario.

window_days.description: Runs created inside the last N days are read; episodes carry no timestamp of their own. Range [1, 90].

run_limit.description: Most recent runs listed before the window filter. Range [1, 200].

top_n.description: How many fingerprints to report, ranked by distinct runs then occurrences.

assumptions: agent-manager is running and its run/list and run/episodes bindings are reachable from the kernel
run/list returns newest first; the window filter is applied to createdAt in the kernel
episodes with ownerConfidence unknown omit suspectedOwnerScenario and never match the scenario input
each call runs in its own program-runtime session; session variables persist across submissions
the caller treats a partial digest, or one with window_truncated_by_run_limit true, as a lower bound, never as the whole picture
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most run_limit (200) run rows and at most 500 episode projections per run are materialized; every other reading is count or group_by
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
a run whose episodes cannot be read is counted in episode_reads_failed and degrades the status to partial; it is never dropped silently
zero runs inside the window is an empty digest with status ok, never an error

signals.runs_listed: runs returned by run/list before the window filter
signals.runs_in_window: runs whose createdAt is inside window_days
signals.runs_unparseable_timestamp: listed runs whose createdAt could not be parsed; never counted as in-window
signals.window_truncated_by_run_limit: true when every listed run is inside the window and the list stopped at run_limit or the server reports more: older in-window runs were not read, so the digest is a lower bound
signals.earliest_run_created_at: createdAt of the oldest run in the window, so the caller knows what the window really covered; null when runs_in_window is 0
signals.episodes_total: episodes across every run read, all owners
signals.episodes_for_scenario: episodes whose suspectedOwnerScenario equals the input
signals.episode_reads_failed: runs whose episodes binding raised; each is also an errors[] entry
signals.owner_confidence: counts of episodes by ownerConfidence across all owners (manifest-derived, unknown)
signals.recurring_count: fingerprints for the scenario seen in 3 or more distinct runs
signals.top_fingerprints: at most top_n of {fingerprint, occurrences, distinct_runs, pattern, cause_scope, owner_command, owner_confidence, wall_clock_ms}

outputs.evidence: the sensor commands read, with counts; never episode bodies

fixtures.note: A one-day window on a quiet host is legitimately empty: status ok with runs_in_window 0.
